Use the [production skill](../skills/microstation-camtasia-video/SKILL.md)
and [workspace rules](../../AGENTS.md).

Make a smooth 25-second tour of the currently open MicroStation model using my
attached key-frame images. Show this project's capabilities, not a fabricated
construction sequence.

- Record the entire intended monitor, including the complete MicroStation UI
  and the real agent panel beside it. Do not capture unrelated monitors.
- Feature one existing high-detail object I name in chat. Include a readable
  close-up of its smallest important detail, then finish at the wider context
  key frame. If I have not named the feature or monitor and the choice is
  ambiguous, ask once before recording.
- Do not change model geometry, materials or levels. Use native MicroStation
  MCP camera/view operations and restore the original presentation afterwards.
- Test a short representative take first. Make movement smooth and purposeful,
  avoid redundant feature stops and verify complete redraws. Inspect actual
  moving footage for geometry popping and thin-edge artifacts; correct them or
  report a specific blocker. Do not claim no-flicker while shimmer remains.
- Use Camtasia MCP to append the tour after the currently open edit. Save and
  verify a backup first. Preserve all existing clips, in-points, transforms,
  effects, animations, media and project settings. Do not replace an earlier
  clip unless I explicitly specify that replacement interval.
- Deliver 1920x1080 at 30fps, exactly 25 seconds, silent, with no added captions
  or titles. Resolve aspect-ratio/rate conflicts before changing anything.
- Verify decoded output and full-screen composition, feature readability,
  genuine source-frame coverage, model/view preservation and saved Camtasia
  playback. Keep original footage and backups.

Provide the video and editable-project links and a short PASS/unresolved summary.
